title: d&d_rule
summary: The D&D Cyclopedia is a reference volume published by TSR, Inc. that gathers the rules of the Dungeons & Dragons role-playing game into one encyclopedic book. It is aimed at experienced players who want to look up a specific rule quickly, though the text also explains how a newcomer could learn to play from it. The contents cover character creation, including ability scores, classes such as cleric, fighter, magic-user, thief, dwarf, elf, halfling, druid and mystic, and their spells and equipment. Later sections deal with movement, encounters, combat, mass battles, experience, nonplayer characters and stronghold building, followed by guidance for the Dungeon Master, a large monster list, immortals, treasure and magic items, campaign design and the planes of existence. Appendices offer conversion notes for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons, record sheets and indices. The book also introduces the basic roles of players, the Dungeon Master, mapper and caller.
